resources.string: Optional Premium fallback. With full photo access, Notification Control can copy a recent WhatsApp image from shared device media when the notification does not expose a readable image. Selected-photos access is not enough for automatic background recovery. Media stays local.
Photos that look related to received WhatsApp notifications but cannot yet be matched safely are kept locally here instead of being discarded.
Optional second source: select the WhatsApp Images folder. Notification Control receives persistent read access only to the folder you choose.
%1$d media waiting for a safe match
Public release uses direct notification media plus the WhatsApp Images folder you explicitly link below. Broad gallery access is intentionally not requested.
